CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 17, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Mary Zendejas, 1st District  Megan Kerr, 5th District
Cindy Allen, 2nd District  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
Kristina Duggan, 3rd District  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, 7th District
Daryl Supernaw, 4th District  Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, 8th District
  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District
Thomas B. Modica, City Manager
Monique De La Garza, City Clerk  Rex Richardson, Mayor  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney

  REVISED

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

 Para escuchar la reunión del Concejo Municipal en español:

 1. Llame al (213) 338-8477
 2. Introduzca el ID de la reunión: 940 1533 4501 #
 3. Pulse # para unirse a la reunión

 Por favor, tenga en cuenta que, para proporcionar comentarios públicos, deberá asistir a la
 reunión presencial

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 CONSENT CALENDAR (1 – 7)

 1.  26-54574  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $1,850, offset by the Fifth Council District One-Time
  Priority Funds transferred from the Citywide Activities Department to provide a
  contribution to the following organizations:
  • $500 to The LGBTQ Center Long Beach in support of the Long Beach
  Annual Trans Day of Visibility;
  • $500 to ELB Pony Baseball Booster, Inc. in support of the East Long Beach
  Pony Baseball 2026 Season;
  • $350 to the St. Cornelius School in support of the St. Cornelius 2026 Jog-A-
  Thon;
  • $500 to Uptown Long Beach Youth Baseball in support of their 2026
  Season; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $1,850, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Page 1 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 17, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Office or Department:  Megan Kerr, Councilwoman, Fifth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54575  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $4,050, offset by the Seventh Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  support the following:
  1. $550 to the Associated Student Inc., In support of their Westside Silver
  Series at Bret Harte Library;
  2. $1,000 to Long Beach Blast in support of their Breakfast BLAST 2026;
  3. $2,500 to Long Beach Conservation Corp in support of their Dine on Pine
  2026; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $4,050, to offset transfers to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, Seventh District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54565  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City Council meeting of Tuesday,
  March 3, 2026.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54566  Recommendation to refer to City Attorney damage claims received between March
  2, 2026 and March 9, 2026.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54524  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to enter into contracts, including any necessary subsequent
  amendments, in an aggregate total amount of one-time funds not to exceed
  $500,000, for a period of two years, with organizations that contract with the City of
  Long Beach (City) to manage Business Improvement Districts to deliver programs.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Economic Development and Opportunity

  Page 2 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 17, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54525  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute an
  agreement, any necessary documents, and subsequent amendments with
  California State University, Long Beach, to establish a collaborative partnership
  with the City of Long Beach Department of Health and Human Services, Homeless
  Services Bureau’s Mobile Access Center, for a one-year period from April 1, 2026,
  through March 31, 2027, with the option to renew for four additional one-year
  periods at the discretion of the City Manager, at no cost to the City. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54526  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute Facility Use
  Permits with various service providers at the Multi-Service Center for a period of
  five years from January 1, 2026, to December 31, 2030, with the option to renew
  for one additional five-year period at the discretion of the City Manager. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CEREMONIALS AND PRESENTATIONS

  ACS Pet Adoption

  Environmental Health Week

  Women’s History Month

PUBLIC COMMENT: Obtain speaker card from the City Clerk
Opportunity to address the City Council (on non-agenda items) is given to the first 10 persons who
submit Speaker Cards to the City Clerk beginning at 15 minutes prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Each speaker is allowed three minutes to make their comments.

REGULAR AGENDA

8.  26-54533  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary for an Occupancy Agreement with Shree Ganesh, Inc., for
  the use of privately-owned property located at 802 East Pacific Coast Highway for
  a period of one year, with two one-year options to extend, in an amount not to
  exceed $1,768,425, annually. (District 6)

  Page 3 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 17, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Economic Development and Opportunity; Health and
  Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-54532  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute any and all
  documents necessary, including a Standard Offer, Agreement and Escrow
  Instructions for Purchase of Real Estate with Robert W. Atkins and Patricia S.
  Atkins, Trustees of the Atkins Family Trust dated June 10, 2005, for the purchase
  of certain real property located at 1827 Spring Street, Assessor Parcel Number
  7212-003-021, in an amount not to exceed $9,900,000, with an additional
  $199,000, for acquisition-related costs;

  Increase appropriations in the Capital Project Fund Group in the Public Works
  Department by $14,439,962, to fund the purchase of the property, acquisition-
  related costs and to fund tenant improvements, offset by future bond proceeds
  several years hence; and

  Accept Categorical Exemption CE 26-020. (District 5)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Economic Development and Opportunity; Police; Public
  Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 26-54527  Recommendation to adopt resolution approving the Annual and Five-Year Reports
  for the Transportation Improvement, Parks and Recreation Facilities, Fire Facilities
  Impact, Police Facilities Impact, and Sensitive Coastal Resource Impact Fees.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Financial Management

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 26-54528  Recommendation to approve the Fiscal Year 2026 first departmental and fund
  budget appropriation adjustments in accordance with existing City Council policy.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Financial Management

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 4 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 17, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

12. 26-54529  Recommendation to adopt resolution amending the City Salary Schedules effective
  October 18, 2025, November 15, 2025, November 29, 2025, December 27, 2025,
  and January 24, 2026. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

13. 26-54531  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute a
  Memorandum of Understanding with the County of Los Angeles and The Ocean
  Cleanup to support trash and debris mitigation efforts within the Los Angeles River
  and adjoining areas. (District 1)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

ORDINANCE

14. 26-54243  WITHDRAWN
  Recommendation to declare ordinance approving a Zoning Code Amendment
  (ZCA25-001), and adopt the proposed findings related thereto, to amend Long
  Beach Municipal Code (LBMC) Chapters 21.15 and 21.51 of Title 21 (Zoning) to
  introduce and establish new regulations for Microenterprise Home Kitchen
  Operations (MEHKOs) to support proposed changes to Title 5 (Regulation of
  Businesses, Trades and Professions), read and adopted as read. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Community Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

15. 26-54465  WITHDRAWN
  Recommendation to declare ordinance amending Title 5 of the Long Beach
  Municipal Code by amending and restating Chapter 5.35, relating to
  Microenterprise Home Kitchen Operations. Approval of this ordinance will create a
  program that permits home-based food facilities to prepare and sell meals directly
  to consumers, read and adopted as read. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

NEW BUSINESS

  Page 5 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 17, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

16. 26-54641  Recommendation to adopt resolution pursuant to the provisions of Long Beach
  Municipal Code Section 1.15.150, providing for the appointment of Dawn McIntosh
  to the Office of City Attorney, for a full term of four years commencing on the third
  Tuesday of December, 2026; and the cancellation of the Primary Nominating
  Election for City Attorney scheduled to be held on June 2, 2026. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

17. 26-54642  Recommendation to adopt resolution pursuant to the provisions of Long Beach
  Municipal Code Section 1.15.150, providing for the appointment of Doug Haubert
  to the Office of City Prosecutor, for a full term of four years commencing on the
  third Tuesday of December, 2026; and the cancellation of the Primary Nominating
  Election for City Prosecutor scheduled to be held on June 2, 2026. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT: Immediately prior to adjournment
Opportunity is given to those members of the public who have not addressed the City Council on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes unless extended by the City Council.

STANDING COMMITTEE REMINDER

Tuesday, March 17, 2026 – Government Operations and Efficiency Committee (Attorney/Client) at
4:15 P.M., Beach Conference Rm.

Tuesday, April 7, 2026 – Housing and Public Health Committee at 2:30 P.M., Civic Chambers.

HEARING REMINDER

Tuesday, March 24, 2026 – Hearing for Consideration of a Zoning Code Amendment and Local
Coastal Program Amendment for changes to the Zoning Regulations for the Mobile Food Facilities
(i.e. Mobile Food Trucks) Ordinance. (Citywide)
